message.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Ms Lechner, thank you for your offer. We confirm the enquiry volume of 6110 units annually for the specified contract period and attach our shared forecast as planning evidence, not an extension of our binding commitments. We value continuity of supply and a stable fixed price. In exchange for earlier payment, please consider the attached reduced fixed-price package, with the remaining enquiry terms unchanged. The attached opportunity for additional business is conditional, not an additional volume commitment. Could you approve this package or submit it to your pricing committee, while keeping your existing offer available for comparison?

Our shared forecast snapshot 2026-09 plans 6110 pc for 2026-10 through 2027-09 (fc:350011@2026-09); this is planning evidence, with binding volume and delivery obligations limited to the case terms.

Today you supply only part of our need for Motor IE3 4 kW, 4-pole (part:350010, our total need about 8,490 pc a year); a competitive base price here would put you first in line for a larger share of that business.

Package 1: 6110 units per year; 12 months; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP; quality 250 ppm; EUR 0.0 per complaint; effective 2027-01-01; tooling EUR 0; EUR 363.9 per unit; no index clause.

standing.uncertainty: Independent cost scenarios, not calibrated probabilities or a predicted score. Public should-cost scenario is shown separately. Acceptance is not sustainability.

continuation_risk.objective_warning: Cash fallback loss is business context, NOT Arena score loss. The only negotiation reward at risk is improvement already secured. Accepting an unchanged opening offer locks in zero improvement; a feasible beneficial counter may still earn improvement even when the fallback is expensive.

offer_history.limitation: Few, non-independent past exchanges. This interval is descriptive, not predictive.

question_history.limitation: Few, non-independent past exchanges. This interval is descriptive, not predictive.

continuation_risk.forecast_limitations: Package response estimates omit final-warning hazard. Break-even assumes EVERY non-walkout wins the target. Expected gain assumes counters preserve the current offer; reality can be worse. No guarantee that it stays available.
continuation_risk.decision_rule: At a final warning or repeated unchanged offers, continuation needs an explicit gain/loss justification. Remaining moves are not permission from the supplier. For questions, identify the answer that would change the decision. Astra decides.

selection.rationale: Moderating our fixed-price request to p2 preserves full supply coverage and early payment while seeking another €9,835 of modelled total-cost improvement, including the active relationship penalty, rather than closing at €5,961 secured savings. Seek a fixed-price counter now, then consider one rebased indexed exchange only if necessary and still open; a useful intermediate counter has value even without exact acceptance.
selection.reply_text: Dear Ms Lechner, thank you for revising your offer and taking our volume evidence and earlier payment into account. We retain the confirmed enquiry volume and early-payment terms, and have moderated our price request in the attached package. We prefer a fixed-price agreement for continuity and planning stability, with all remaining enquiry terms unchanged. Could you approve this revised package, or submit it to the responsible pricing committee, while keeping your current offer available for comparison?

plan.basis: Comparable second-stage moderation produced progress when paired with indexation; a fixed-only counter is a subjective forecast, not an observed commitment.
plan.if_counteroffer: Compare the complete counter's relationship-adjusted total cost and consider closing meaningful fixed-price progress.
plan.if_unchanged: Acknowledge the fixed-price boundary and assess one p3 indexed exchange before deciding whether to close.
plan.if_accepted: Prefer closing the improved fixed-price package unless new evidence supports a materially better exchange.
plan.if_walkout: Record the loss of secured Arena improvement and proceed through the fallback process.
plan.why_not_alternative: p3 has historical willingness support but less calibrated savings, greater relationship downside and a public-cost total above opening; preserve it rather than offer it alongside the preferred fixed package now.
plan.revision_from_previous: The predicted counter arrived within range; follow the prior plan's moderated fixed-price step rather than repeat the original request.

continuation_review.risk_reason: This subjective range reflects recent progress, no final warning and histories dominated by counters, without treating remaining moves as patience. It is below the optimistic 62.26% break-even threshold, but that threshold overstates safety because not every surviving reply improves the offer.
continuation_review.information_needed: Whether a moderated fixed-price package is executable determines whether to close fixed pricing or consider the historically supported indexed alternative.
continuation_review.stop_condition: After this moderated request, close meaningful fixed-price progress; if unchanged and still open, consider at most one rebased indexed exchange, then close the best executable positive-improvement offer on another unchanged response or any final warning.

actual_reply.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we appreciate the confirmation of the annual volume and the offer of 14 days net payment. In response to these improved terms, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €368.68.

Our present Angebot is structured with a price of €368.68 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and your preference for a fixed-price agreement. In recognition of your movement, we are prepared to make a further concession to €367.84 per unit. 

Our offer comprises a price of €367.84 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this demonstrates our commitment to a stable partnership and look forward to your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
